header: Russian pogroms in Europe. Zionist movement begins to form.
First wave of Jewish immigrants begin to settle (Aliyah) in Palestine.
content: Foundation of Rishon Lezion, Zichron Yaacov, and Rosh Pina in Palestine.

First used by Nathan Birnbaum in publications of Kadimah, a Jewish student association in Vienna.

While instrumental in the Zionist Congresses, later in life (~1919), Birnbaum would convert to Orthodox Judaism and reject political Zionism in favor of Jewish cultural autonomy.

header: Jewish Colonization Association (JCA) founded by Baron Maurice de Hirsch
content: Its aim was to facilitate the mass emigration of Jews from Russia and other Eastern European countries, by settling them in agricultural settlements on lands purchased by the committee in North America (Canada and the United States), South America (Argentina and Brazil) and Palestine (then part of the Ottoman Empire).

header: Der Judenstaat published by Theodor Herzl
content: Popularized the term 'Zionism'. Originally called 'Address to the Rothschilds', the pamphlet advocated for the establishment of a Jewish state as a solution to anti-Semitism in Europe.

header: First Zionist Congress held in Basel, Switzerland
Second Zionist Congress held in Basel, Switzerland
content: Jüdische Kolonialbank (Jewish Colonial Bank) is established (incorporated in London, UK) to support Jewish settlement in Palestine.
A French Jewish army officer is wrongfully convicted of treason, highlighting widespread anti-Semitism in Europe.

header: Jewish National Fund established at the Fifth Zionist Congress
Second wave of Jewish migration (Aliyah) from Europe

content: This is the operational arm of the World Zionist Organization. It will later become the Jewish Executive, found the Haganah, and eventually evolve into the Jewish Agency.
Founded by two Palestinian Christian brothers, the paper became a leading voice against Zionism.
The correspondence between the British High Commissioner in Egypt and the Sharif of Mecca, promising Arab independence in exchange for support against the Ottoman Empire.
In a letter from Lord Balfour to Baron Rothschild, the British government avows support for a Jewish state.
The League of Nations formally approved the British Mandate for Palestine.
14-17% of the adult male population is killed/wounded/exiled in the Arab Revolt against the British Mandate, demanding independence and the end of open-ended Jewish immigration and land purchases.
Rejects Peel Commission's recommendation to partition, limits Jewish immigration and land purchases. Zionist groups oppose it and launch militant attacks against British targets.

header: The Biltmore Conference - demands for the entirety of Mandatory Palestine

content: The United Nations General Assembly adopted Resolution 181 (II), which recommended the adoption and implementation of a Plan of Partition with Economic Union.
David Ben-Gurion proclaims the establishment of the State of Israel.
